profile.headline: Embedded Systems
profile.summary: Robotics has been such an integral part of my life that I decided to invest the majority of my time in engineering. Ever since high school, I have spent every second I could with my robotics team because their companionship, morals, and ideas mean a lot to me. The people I met, the learning I underwent, and the fulfillment of the mission to bring science and technology to underprivileged kids became the focus of my life in high school. Even if I had to deprive myself of sleep and quit basketball in order to make time for robotics, pursuing my passion was worth it. Even after graduating high school, I couldn't walk away from robotics. Currently, graduated from the University of Washington, with a degree in Electrical computer engineering degree, I hope to focus on consumer tech that can help others on a large scale

positions.title: Software Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Debugging problems in Surface Uefi and managing monthly updates.
Set up CI pipeline on Azure Dev Ops to run automated unit tests each night.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
-	Implemented Firmware to manage audio routing configuration, clock management, power sequencing of Cirrus DSP on a wireless battery-powered audio device
-	Characterized bare metal firmware on dual-mode Bluetooth radio 
-	Developed Python scripts to integrate audio tunings from overseas vendor to meet audio specifications

positions.title: Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
Used Altium to design 50+ modular boards for hardware prototyping kit to simplify low power IOT hardware
Schematic/layout/routing of HDI & flex rigid boards including high speed digital circuit design, wireless comm parts, analog circuits, battery powered and charging circuits with considerations for
DFM and EMI
Firmware development of low power IOT systems in free RTOS using C and Dialog SDK.

positions.title: Undergrad Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developing inexpensive CMOS based camera for soft X-ray spectrometer; PCB schematic, layout,
board bring up and validation testing.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Designed bed of nails schematic with low power measurement, MCU communication and external power circuit
Testing and validating products by measuring signal timing and integrity, Power, and RF output

positions.title: Powertrain Test Lab Engineer intern
positions.description:
Using  python scripts for test automation, image and data processing
Designing data logging equipment with embedded linux microcomputer  to replace $1000 equipment

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Made a Triac based AC motor variable speed controller with pic microcontroller
Ran tests to characterize motors and check validity for current and future product revisions

positions.title: Web Devolpment Intern
positions.description:
-	Built login, recipe crafter, parts cataloger, and contact page using asp.net objects, JavaScript, and databases
-	Fixed lathe for better precision and lathed fittings  with one thou tolerance
-	Tested and optimized production assemblies for efficiency and cost

volunteerExperiences.description:
-Installed security cameras and Radio frequency Identification(RFID) access control system inside workshop
-Made workbenches and tables out of recycled wood
-Painted walls and cleaned up area
-Presented the importance of STEM at openhouse

-Started STEM pilot program that would be used in other elementary schools.
-Introduced STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) to 8–11 year olds through WeDo Robotics and Lego Mindstorms

projects.title: Free-zer
projects.description: Account based website where students can easily pick out their classes and compare them with other students to find an optimal meeting time. Python was used to scrape UW time schedule and put into SQL databases

projects.title: ARF-ID
projects.description: An automatic dog feeder that opens up when a dog and its RFID dog tag comes within proximity at a pre programmed time of the day

organizations.name: UW Formula Motorsports Team
organizations.position: Electronics and Sponsorship Division · Jan 2012 - Present
organizations.description:
-Pioneered electronics team consisted mainly of mechanical engineers
-Designed  wireless torque sensor PCB based off Arduino platform using radio frequency modules with eagle and low weight 3d printed housing in SolidWorks
-Worked with carbon fiber reinforced polymer composites  and honeycomb to build a strong light weight structure for the  car
-Contacted firms for sponsorship  and acquired vital pieces necessary for the car
-Fascilittated placement of over 100 sponsors’ decals on car.

organizations.name: UW Robotics Team Dawgbytes
organizations.description:
-Participating in University Rover competition to build a robot that would need to do similar tasks to that of a Martian rover
-Mechanical sub-team leader in charge of the guidance and progress of
sample analysis and mechanical support systems
